transcript.content: Hello, welcome. What brings you in to see me today?

Hi. Thank you so much for taking the time to see me. Um, well, I guess I'm here because I've just been feeling really, really worn down lately. I hope I'm explaining this right, and I really don't want to come across as difficult or, you know, dramatic... but I work as a phlebotomist, so I deal with bloodwork all the time. 

For the past year, I’ve been trying to... well, I've been trying to prove that someone in the clinic system is changing or maybe holding back parts of my dad’s lab results. I know how that sounds, I really do. My family and all his doctors keep telling me the numbers are perfectly fine, and I hate causing a fuss with them. I always try to listen to the doctors. But I just... I know the chart doesn’t match what I originally saw. I know it doesn't. And trying to get it sorted out is just completely wearing me down. 

Is it okay that I'm starting with that? I just really hope you don't think poorly of me, I'm just so exhausted from trying to fix it.
During this past year, have you ever heard voices or sounds that other people couldn't hear?

Oh, um, no. No, definitely not. I've never heard voices or anything like that. 

I completely understand why you have to ask, though, and I don't mind at all! I know my situation probably sounds a little intense. But no, it's nothing like that. My hearing is perfectly normal, and I promise I'm not... you know, I'm not imagining things in my head or hearing things that aren't there. It's really just the physical lab charts and the data that I'm dealing with. 

I hope that makes sense? I just want to make sure I'm giving you the right information and being as helpful as possible.

Oh, um, outside of that? No, everything else is... it's completely normal. I really hope it doesn't seem like I'm just walking around suspicious of everyone, because I'm definitely not! I promise. 

Outside of this whole dispute with my dad's records, I'm doing fine. I still go to all my phlebotomy shifts, I pay my bills on time... I take good care of myself and just manage all my normal day-to-day responsibilities without any issues. It's really just this one specific thing with the clinic system that I'm trying to fix. I get along great with my coworkers and my friends. 

Is that what you were asking? I just want to make sure I'm answering your question right, and I hope that shows I'm really trying to keep everything else in my life on track.
